title: DNA and RNA building blocks found in meteorites

tellings.quote: Speaking of DNA, it was just a few years back when a group of scientists from Japan and NASA actually confirmed something extraordinary.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that a few years ago a group of scientists from Japan and from NASA, the US space agency, confirmed something extraordinary: the basic building blocks of DNA and RNA, the molecules that carry genetic information, inside meteorites that fell in Canada, the US and Australia. He raises it because it would mean some of the ingredients of life can arrive from space.
